title: A transaction releases its connection after an auto-commit restore error
summary: A failed auto-commit restore now still releases the R2DBC loan. A rollback failure retained its translated cause and another checkout obtained the freed slot.

change.description: Cleanup handles an error signal from restoring auto-commit and continues to release a newly held connection. A release error signal is also suppressed during cleanup.

notes: Only a subscription to the driver's cold close publisher credits the slot. A second checkout tests that independently.
